title: Retry backoff
skill: Give the exact attempt and delay schedule

good: In src/lib/retry.js, retry(fn, { retries, baseMs, maxMs, sleep }) calls fn only retries times, waits baseMs * (attempt + 1), sleeps after the last failure, and throws a new "gave up" error. Rules: call fn up to retries + 1 times; before retry i (i = 0, 1, 2, ...) await sleep(Math.min(baseMs * 2 ** i, maxMs)); no sleep after the last failure; return the first success; if all calls fail, throw the last error object itself (no wrapper). Wait only through the sleep option. Only change that file. Then run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/*.test.js
lazy: The retry logic in the weather client is off. Fix it.
